summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation covering atomic reservation, priority handling, idempotent order IDs, and immutability constraints based on stakeholder interviews.

requirements.description: Orders must be reserved atomically across all lines after aggregating repeated SKUs; if any line cannot be fulfilled or has unknown stock, no stock is deducted.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: A warehouse stock level and an order requesting multiple lines or repeated SKUs
acceptance.when: Stock reservation is attempted for the order
acceptance.then: All quantities are deducted together if sufficient stock exists, or no stock is deducted if any line fails

requirements.description: Expedited orders must be prioritized and processed before normal orders, preserving original arrival order within each priority tier.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A batch of orders containing both expedited and normal priority items
acceptance.then: All valid expedited orders are processed in arrival order before any normal orders are processed

requirements.description: Order identifiers must be idempotent such that only the first occurrence of an ID is processed and any subsequent duplicates are completely ignored.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: An order batch containing multiple orders with the same order identifier
acceptance.then: The first occurrence claims the identifier and subsequent occurrences are ignored without generating further acceptances or rejections

requirements.description: Invalid order lines and invalid orders must be rejected without mutating stock, and caller input objects must never be modified.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Input stock and order objects that may contain invalid lines, invalid orders, or successful reservations
acceptance.then: Rejected orders do not change stock, and original stock and order input objects remain unmutated

assumptions: Stock levels are non-negative safe integers keyed by non-empty SKU strings.
Invalid stock input causes a TypeError to be thrown immediately.
Order priority must be either 'expedited' or 'normal'; other priority values result in rejection with reason 'invalid_order'.
Repeated SKUs within an order line list are aggregated before checking stock availability.
Rejections for invalid orders are reported in input order before reservation failures in processing order.
